families.label: Droplet single-cell or single-nucleus RNA sequencing
families.note: Portal titles propose the family. Reviewers must verify that the configuration represents the RNA modality of a droplet assay.

families.label: Combinatorial-indexing RNA sequencing
families.note: SHARE-seq also matches the joint multiome family. The candidate builder preserves both proposals for adjudication.

families.label: Single-cell or single-nucleus ATAC sequencing
families.note: Reviewers must verify single-cell or single-nucleus context and the represented ATAC modality.

families.label: Joint RNA and chromatin multiome sequencing
families.note: A configuration file may represent only one modality of a joint experiment. Reviewers must verify the linked configuration pair.

families.label: Perturbation or guide-capture sequencing
families.note: Reviewers must verify that the configuration contains the perturbation or guide-capture measurement rather than only a companion expression read.

families.label: Protein, feature, or sample-tag barcoding
families.note: Reviewers must verify that the configuration contains the feature or sample-tag modality rather than only a companion RNA or ATAC read.
